title: African Market OS-MVR API public preflight evidence item
description: A caller-declared, consented and redacted evidence item. No required fields at intake: incomplete items receive correction feedback. Explicit artifact_role, evidence_role, source_role, record_role and content_role declarations admit only original_source_record, independent_evaluation or human_attestation; other declared roles are rejected with ARTIFACT_ROLE_NOT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE. Omission remains supported for legacy items. Passing coverage never verifies truth, permission or readiness.

id.description: Optional item identifier. Does not establish a distinct source.

claim.description: Minimal, non-confidential claim supported by the item; do not send raw private interviews.

evidence_type.description: What was collected, for example interview, field observation or licence record. Not merely the conclusion.

source_class.description: Origin label, for example entity_reported, regulator_published, structured_field_research, operational_data or counterparty_reference. model_inferred is not source evidence and is rejected with ARTIFACT_ROLE_NOT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE. Never relabel it to pass. Origin is not a claim of independence.

evidence_origin.description: Declared source origin. Explicit public/documentary sources are not caller fieldwork solely because evidence_type is survey. Conflicting explicit field origins still block; never relabel to pass.

source_family.description: Compatibility origin label. Explicit field/public conflicts, including provenance_ledger.source_family, require reconciliation; one label cannot erase another.

stakeholder_class.description: Role represented, for example guardian, customer, supplier or partner. Do not submit a person identifier.

verification_status.description: Caller label. verified, independently_verified, corroborated, attested, confirmed and validated count for the structural prefilter only. self_attested, unverified, missing and other labels do not. Do not change labels without actually checking the source.

source_grade.description: Caller-supplied grade. Not a substitute for verification or source lineage.

source_date.description: Declared source date, YYYY-MM-DD or ISO timestamp with timezone. Date validity and age can be checked; the source and current applicability remain unverified.

freshness_date.description: Compatibility alias for source_date; conflicting supplied dates require correction.

country.description: Declared source country, not the target country.

district.description: Nonblank declared source district, not verified local coverage.

districts.description: Declared source districts, each a nonblank string. An empty array is allowed. Not verified fieldwork or representative coverage.

geography.description: Source country name/code or broader description, or an object with country, city, region and town_or_zone strings, a nonblank district string and a districts array of nonblank strings (empty allowed). Known country conflicts, including conflicting evidence_geography.country, are flagged; local applicability is not authenticated.

source_doc_id.description: Opaque source-document reference, not an evidence-item ID or personal identifier.

source_locator.description: Redacted document-specific locator, not the shared folder holding unrelated documents. Never invent a locator. Genuine shared upstream references count together.

source_url.description: Source reference only; the sandbox does not fetch or authenticate it.

upstream_source_ids.description: Disclose shared upstream sources; distinct identifiers do not prove independence.

source_hash.description: Optional SHA-256 source hash, 64 hexadecimal characters; a hash does not authenticate its origin.

provenance_ledger.description: Field evidence needs source_doc_id and an explicit parent_source_ids array (empty allowed). Unknown lineage stays incomplete, not invented.

upstream_source_ids.description: Disclose shared upstream sources; distinct identifiers do not prove independence.

source_family.description: Declared source family; distinct labels do not prove independence.

synthetic_fields.description: Source-reference fields that were generated rather than observed; these do not establish lineage.

collection_context.description: Source-grounded collection declarations, not source authentication. Unknown facts must remain missing; do not invent values to pass. Field decision use requires source modality, collector relationship, interview mode, source-document identity and an explicit parent-source list. Collector-administered modes require staffing, duration, available minutes per collector and sample size. Group modes additionally require session_count, participants_per_session, session_duration_minutes and collectors_per_session, never inferred from an individual interview duration. Online, observation and administrative_record modes require collection_administration; self-administered online and automated observation/record sources do not need invented collector capacity. Explicit public/documentary origins are not caller fieldwork solely because evidence_type is survey; conflicting explicit field origins still block. Independent verification labels require a separate reviewer relationship; persisted review is still checked separately.

collection_administration.description: Source-grounded administration, required for online, observation and administrative_record modes. self_administered is supported for online; automated for observation or administrative_record. Face-to-face, telephone and group modes are collector-administered and cannot opt out.

interview_duration_minutes.description: Collector time per individual interview or per observed/processed sample record for collector-administered non-group modes.

fieldwork_window_minutes.description: Total available collection minutes per collector across the entire period, not daily or team-person-minutes.

session_count.description: Actual number of group sessions in the source records.

participants_per_session.description: Source-grounded maximum participants in any session. Sample size cannot exceed session_count times this bound; no default group size is assumed.

session_duration_minutes.description: Source-recorded duration of each group session in this declaration, not an alias for individual interview duration.

collectors_per_session.description: Collectors required concurrently for each group session, drawn from enumerator_count. No default facilitator count is assumed.

source_extraction.description: Optional caller-supplied second reading of source facts for conflict comparison only. Not independently authenticated; cannot supply missing primary declarations or establish source authenticity.

sample_size.description: Actual sample size; required for collector-administered modes, including groups. Group sample cannot exceed session_count times participants_per_session. All supplied aliases must agree; never invent a sample for documentary or self-administered evidence.

survey_payload.description: Existing sample_size alias; all supplied sample-size aliases must agree.

load_bearing.description: True if the target recommendation materially depends on this item.
